info.title: QILSRP App API
info.description: This API provides access to the QILSRP Leadership Program website

post.description: Log in to an existing user account. A request body containing the user credentials must be sent.

requestBody.description: The credentials of the user to log in. Click on 'Schema' to see all options.

examples: Request body incomplete, password is required
Request body incomplete, one of email or mobile is required
User has not yet been verified by an administrator

put.description: Change the currently authenticated user's password

requestBody.description: An object containing the user's current and new password

401.description: Unauthorized. Click on 'Schema' below to see the possible error responses.

400.description: Invalid body. Click on 'Schema' below to see the possible error responses.

examples: Request body incomplete, both currentPassword and newPassword are required
Password must contain at least 8 characters
Password must contain a capital letter
Password must contain a special character

post.description: Sends a request for a new user account, or if the user is an admin, immediately creates the account. A request body containing the user to be registered must be sent.

requestBody.description: An object containing the name, email, password, cohort, and role of the user to be registered.

examples: User created. If you are not an admin please wait to be verified.

400.description: Bad request. Click on 'Schema' to see the possible error responses.

examples: Request body incomplete: name, password, cohort, and role are required.
Request body incomplete: one of email address or mobile number is required.
Email must be a valid email
Password must contain at least 8 characters
Password must contain a capital letter
Password must contain a special character
Role must be one of 'student', 'ranger', or 'admin'

put.description: Verify the specified pending user as an admin.

examples: Current user is not authorised to perform this function

401.description: Unauthorized. Click on 'Schema' below to see the possible error responses.

404.description: User not found or is not pending verification

examples: User not found or is not pending verification

get.description: Returns a selection of users' profile information

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: If this parameter is present, only users with this name will be returned (case-sensitive)

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: If this parameter is present, only users with this email will be returned

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: If this parameter is present, only users with this status will be returned (admin-only)

parameters.name: cohort
parameters.description: If this parameter is present, only users in the specified cohort will be returned (admin-only)

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: If this parameter is present, only users in the specified role will be returned

200.description: An array of objects containing user_id, name, email, status, date created, role, and cohort. If a non-privilidged user uses this endpoint, the status, date created, and cohort information will be omitted, and will only return verified users within that user's cohort.

401.description: Unauthorized. Click on 'Schema' below to see the possible error responses.
